With Magi and Yaeko now helping him find more spirits, the mysterious Mogura may finally achieve his peculiar dream.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Busamen Gachi Fighter

alternative_titles.ja: ブサメンガチファイター

items.synopsis:
Wrongly convicted of a crime, 34-year-old Shigeru Yoshioka loses everything, including his trust in women, and withdraws from society as an unemployed recluse.

One day, he stumbles upon a way to travel to another world. When a mysterious status screen appears on his computer, Shigeru sacrifices his looks to gain an overwhelming 100 trillion and 5,100 parameters. Now reborn as an "Absolute God," he begins his second life in another world.

(Source: MAL News)

items.title: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?)

alternative_titles.en: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...
alternative_titles.ja: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ! (※ムリじゃなかった!?)

items.synopsis:
Seeing everyone else enjoying their youth, socially anxious Renako Amaori is dead set on becoming an extroverted girl. Despite her reclusive past, she changes her appearance, practices conversation, and enrolls in a high school free of anyone that would know her. While she is quickly able to befriend the famous model Mai Ouzuka, after Renako joins her friend group, she realizes pretending to be a completely different person is no easy feat.

Soon, Renako and Mai have a heart-to-heart and share their troubles with each other. After the sincere discussion, Renako truly believes they could become best friends. The very next day, however, the unthinkable happens—Mai confesses her love to Renako! Although Renako is not interested in dating, Mai insists the two begin hanging out alternately as friends and a couple, while figuring out which type of relationship suits them better.

Determined to create a blissful friendship, Renako tries her best to convince the stubborn Mai. However, Renako herself might have a change of heart as Mai's advances continue to get bolder.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Anne Shirley
items.synopsis:
Eleven-year-old orphan Anne Shirley has spent her life moving from one family to another, always hoping to find a place where she truly belongs. When she is sent to live with elderly siblings Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert at Green Gables, a quiet farm in the town of Avonlea, it is quickly revealed that she is there by mistake. Having expected a boy able to help out with farm work, the Cuthberts are surprised to instead receive a young girl with a vivid imagination and a flair for the dramatic.

Despite the Cuthberts' initial hesitation, Anne's energy, intelligence, and charm soon win them over. Anne settles into her new life, experiencing many things for the first time—such as attending school and making close friends—as she learns to navigate the joys and challenges of growing up.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Cat's♥Eye
items.synopsis: The protagonists of the series are the three Kisugi sisters—Hitomi, Rui and Ai—who run a café called Cat's Eye. The sisters lead a double life as a trio of highly skilled art thieves, leaving cards with the name "Cat's Eye" at the scene of their crimes. They steal works of art that belonged to their long-missing father, Heinz who was a famous art collector during the Nazi regime, in the hopes of him contacting them. Toshio, the police officer investigating this case is the fiancé of Hitomi. He also swears to capture and bring down the Cat's Eye Gang.

items.title: Uchuujin MuuMuu
items.synopsis:
A cat-like alien from a distant galaxy, MuuMuu, arrives on Earth. His goal is to learn about home appliance technology on Earth to recover the technology his species has lost. The protagonist, Sakurako, has a typical university life, but everything changes with MuuMuu's arrival! What begins as an unexpected cohabitation quickly turns into a whirlwind of chaotic events. The chemistry between Sakurako and MuuMuu leads to a super-spectacular, appliance-filled, and cat comedy adventure. 

(Source: Pony Canyon)

items.title: Kimi to Idol Precure♪

alternative_titles.ja: キミとアイドルプリキュア♪

items.synopsis:
Uta Sakura is a lively and energetic middle school student who loves singing.
One day, while walking her dog, she encounters a cute, peach-like fairy named Purirun, who is searching for the Legendary Protectors "Idol Precure." Purirun's hometown, KirakiLand, was a peaceful, sparkly place but has been forced into darkness by the villainous Darkine, leader of the Chokkiri Gang. Uta decides to help Purirun search for cheerful and happy people to become the Precure so KirakiLand can become bright again.
Suddenly, the Chokkiri gang arrive in Hanamichi Town, Uta's hometown, and steal the sparkles from the townspeople. Uta decides to illuminate the darkness with sparkles from her song and is granted the power to transform into the Legendary Protector, Cure Idol.

items.title: Cang Yuan Tu 2
items.synopsis: The second season of Cang Yuan Tu.

items.title: Yuanshen: Juese PVs
items.synopsis: Animated character trailers for the game Genshin Impact, the animation is unique and is not present in the game.

items.title: Takopii no Genzai
items.synopsis:
A squid-like creature, known as a Happian, leaves his home planet with the desire to spread happiness across the universe. He lands on Earth, but quickly finds himself in danger of captivity by its inhabitants. Fortunately, he is found by an unsmiling little girl named Shizuka Kuze, who feeds him and names him Takopii. Feeling indebted, Takopii decides to do everything in his power to bring a smile to her face.

The task is easier said than done, however. Shizuka is bullied by her classmates, she does not have a father, and her mother is never home—though the gravity of these issues flies over the naive Takopii's head. Even so, Shizuka does have one source of happiness: her dog Chappy. The connection Shizuka and Chappy share only increases Takopii's desire to make the girl smile.

While Takopii's attempts to lift Shizuka's spirits lead to unintended consequences, he is determined to take things into his own tentacles, test his understanding of human beings, and achieve his goal of spreading happiness.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Necronomico no Cosmic Horror Show

alternative_titles.en: Necronomico and the Cosmic Horror Show
alternative_titles.ja: ネクロノミ子のコズミックホラーショウ

items.synopsis:
Miko Kurono is a lesser-known streamer, "Necronomico," who plays video games for her small audience. She has been covering the hospital bills of her close friend and fellow streamer, Mayu Mayusaka, ever since she and other popular streamers mysteriously fell into a coma three months ago.

Desperate for money, Miko agrees to participate in a top-secret beta test for a cutting-edge VR game. After clearing the first level, she and six other streamers come face-to-face with the Old Ones—ancient, evil gods who have returned to take over the Earth but are currently trapped inside the VR world. Miko becomes enraged when she discovers that one of the gods, Cthulhu, has taken the likeness of Mayu and is the one responsible for her condition.

Alongside the others, Miko is now a part of the Old Ones' twisted game called the Cosmic Horror Show, where the elimination of all the players results in humanity's doom. However, knowing that the winner is granted a single wish, Miko sets out to beat the game and save Mayu.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Araiguma Calcal-dan

alternative_titles.ja: あらいぐま カルカル団

items.synopsis: A short-form slice of life anime about a team of secret agent racoons in an office who are. Each episode presents a new gag.

items.title: Food Court de, Mata Ashita.

synonyms: See You at the Food Court Tomorrow.
Food Court de Joshikousei ga Shaberu daku
alternative_titles.en: See You Tomorrow at the Food Court
alternative_titles.ja: フードコートで、また明日。

items.synopsis:
Every afternoon, tucked away in a corner of a local shopping mall's food court, two high school girls unwind and share a meal. Wada may seem like a soft-spoken honor student, but she is actually quite talkative and has an addiction to mobile games. Meanwhile, Yamamoto appears to be a stoic gal, but she is obsessed with internet mysteries and all things American. Nevertheless, within this food court, they carve out a strong friendship built on unfiltered conversations and the little absurdities that make everyday life a bit more bearable.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Tsuihousha Shokudou e Youkoso!

alternative_titles.ja: 追放者食堂へようこそ!

items.synopsis:
Thrown out of the Silver Wings Battalion—one of the strongest guilds—Dennis is presented with the opportunity to fulfill his dream: opening a restaurant and putting his level 99 cooking skills to use. While setting up his new business, Dennis stumbles across a young enslaved girl named Atelier, seemingly of noble lineage. Reminded of his own past, he decides to free Atelier and hire her as a server.

As the restaurant opens its doors to first guests, Dennis and Atelier begin encountering more outcasts like themselves, all looking to talk about their personal problems over plates of delicious food. Unable to resist helping someone in need, Dennis goes out of his way to help with his customers' issues, whether it be with his incredible combat skills or unmatched cooking prowess.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Koupen-chan
items.synopsis:
A baby emperor penguin, Koupen-chan, always makes sure everyone feels included. As it meets its newest friend, Koupen-chan wishes to spend as much time as possible with them and brighten up their day.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Everyday Host
items.synopsis:
The story follows Hajime Sekiguchi, a former life insurance salesman who, in a moment of desperation, makes the unexpected leap into the world of hosts.

At Club One, Hajime finds himself surrounded by a cast of eccentric personalities: a "younger brother" type host with 20 years of experience, a former idol specializing in romantic sales tactics, and a hyper-aggressive host obsessed with mobile games. Despite thinking, "This isn't a job for anyone with a sane mind," Hajime uses his polished insurance sales skills to attract clients and carve out a surprising niche for himself.

(Source: MAL News)

items.title: Dandadan 2nd Season
items.synopsis:
While the mission to exorcise Jin "Jiji" Enjouji's family home is underway, things are not going as expected. Momo Ayase narrowly evades an attempted abduction while Ken "Okarun" Takakura and Jiji are ambushed by the Kitou family—the unsettling landlords of the cursed estate. The trio's efforts threaten the foundation of this enigmatic town shrouded in legends and mysteries.

As Momo, Okarun, and Jiji are drawn deeper into the maze of folklore and supernatural entities, they must each utilize their unique powers if they want to survive and unravel the secrets of the uncanny town.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Fanren Xiu Xian Zhuan 4th Season

synonyms: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality 4th Season

Jiang Jun, Xian Shu, Fo Yan, Xuan Jiao, Ying Yuan, Ren Qu, and Xia Guai are among the many unusual and enigmatic creatures they meet along the route. They also face off against the formidable ultimate boss behind the Fairy Album in an exciting battle of cunning. There's a voyage of mystery, legend, and imagination ahead!

The prime minister of Guyu Kingdom's eldest daughter, Qian Yunxi, possesses superhuman abilities.  Since childhood, she has been viewed as unlucky, and she is compelled to marry into the Ye Palace.  When the prince Ye Youming sees how sincere and nice she is, he employs hundreds of tricks to demonstrate his generosity.  Because she believes the prince is malicious, Qian Yunxi argues with him.  Cohabitation turns into a tumultuous existence.

(Source: Bilibili)

items.synopsis:
Hao Ren was originally a young man who lived in a fourth-tier city and lived on the meager rent of an old house. When he went out to work, he accidentally became a "universe police officer." While he was still struggling to accommodate a group of abnormal creature tenants arranged by his superiors, his jurisdiction, the Dream Plane Universe, had already brewed a cosmic crisis. The mystery of the origin of abnormal creatures on Earth and the ruins of civilization in the Dream Plane Universe seem to be connected in some way. 

As Hao Ren's investigation deepened, the eldest son's world-destroying natural disaster, the goddess of creation fell, and one after another of the dusty and terrifying cases that had been buried for thousands of years bombarded his already useless brain circuit. Hao Ren gradually realized that he might not be able to slack off...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Twenty years ago, numerous "Spiritual Ruins Gates" suddenly appeared all over the world. The spiritual energy gushing out of them would awaken the supernatural powers of those who came into contact with them. These people who awakened supernatural powers were called "Spirit Warriors". Among them, the "Space series" Spirit Warriors became the strongest because of their outstanding performance in the "Beast Tide Disaster" and the scarcity of their awakening. Jiang Nan grew up in an orphanage in Jiangcheng, Lingzhou. He aspired to become the top spiritual warrior since he was a child. At the age of sixteen, he awakened the strongest and rarest space-based supernatural power, becoming the second space-based supernatural power in Lingzhou. Our story begins here...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

items.title: Futari Solo Camp
items.synopsis:
Gen Kinokura is a solitary camper looking for time away from the crowded city to refresh his mind and enjoy nature. But one day, Gen meets Shizuku Kusano at the supposedly empty campsite. A complete beginner at camping, Shizuku tries to settle in with Gen despite his protests. Gen reluctantly gives in once he notices her lackluster preparation.

Offering advice for her next trip, Gen believes their interaction ends on this occasion. However, Shizuku decides to join his future solo outings to learn more about camping. Although no longer on their own, the two set rules on how to camp together, allowing them a give-and-take experience while still relishing the atmosphere in a form of solitude.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Fermat no Ryouri
items.synopsis:
Since childhood, Gaku Kitada has been fascinated with mathematics. As a student at the prestigious Wels Academy, he aimed to qualify for the Mathematics Olympiad and eventually secure admission to the University of Tokyo to become a great mathematician. His ambitious plans, however, do not come to fruition, as Gaku fails to qualify for the Olympiad's main event due to his anxiety and lack of self-confidence. This disastrous performance, coupled with his decision not to participate in future competitions, leads to his expulsion from the academy.

During this crisis, Gaku meets Kai Asakura, an enigmatic professional chef who recognizes Gaku's peculiar way of cooking that incorporates math to create perfectly synergistic dishes. Despite his initial reservations, Gaku begins to utilize his mathematical perspective to cook, rekindling his love for the subject in the process. Wanting to understand this impulse more, Gaku decides to pivot his career trajectory to one that melds numbers with flavors to find solutions that can satisfy both his mind and the palate of his customers.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.synopsis:
After getting caught up in an accident, Ryou Mihara is reincarnated in the world of Phi as a water magician. Waking up in a remote forest, he sets out to achieve his ideal slow life by living off monsters and refining his magic. Unbeknownst to Ryou, in his second life he has gained the hidden trait "Eternal Youth."

One day, Ryou stumbles across a shipwrecked adventurer named Abel. As Abel requests Ryou to accompany him to the town of Lune, they embark on a journey through mountains infested with monsters. Upon arriving at the town and registering as an adventurer, Ryou's powerful water magic and equipment are unlike anything anyone has ever seen before. Although his prowess piques the interest of many, Ryou is eager to begin his own adventure and hone his magic even further!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

White Rabbit, Caterpillar, Queen of Hearts, Card Soldiers, Mad Hatter, March Hare, Humpty Dumpty, Tweedle Dum and Tweedle Dee who are twins, Cheshire Cat and... The residents of Wonderland appear before Rise one after another! And the crazy commotion that ensues!

Therefore, when three women: Ciel, Anemone, and Goa suddenly request to join him, Toto is overjoyed. Unbeknownst to him, they are all assassins assigned to eliminate him!

While Toto resolves to protect his would-be killers, the women fight over who can finish off the hero. As Toto remains oblivious of his new party members' true intentions and finds himself passing out every time he gets flustered, the four of them embark on their peculiar adventure into the greater world.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Sent by his mother to check up on him, Yui forces herself inside his personal living space. Despite Yui already being married, the seemingly normal visit takes a sudden turn when they get drunk and spend a night together. As he is invited for more drinks by other married women, Tsuyoshi finds himself sharing all kinds of intimate moments with them.

items.title: As One
items.synopsis:
The movie follows You, a high school student in modern-day Japan who dreams of becoming a musician but struggles with family opposition and conflicts within his band. One day, while walking through Shibuya, he hears a desperate voice calling for help, and a blinding white light engulfs him.

Meanwhile, far across the cosmos, the celestial body Meguriboshi is on the brink of war over the energy source known as "Hoshichi" (Star Blood). Just as a ceasefire is about to be negotiated between the warring nations, a massive orbital debris field descends, threatening disaster. Laco, a young mechanic, rushes to aid the planet's defense force but finds herself in grave danger. As she falls into unconsciousness, her mind connects with You's, marking the beginning of their intertwined fates.

(Source: MAL News)

items.title: Onmyou Kaiten Re:Birth
items.synopsis:
Teenage delinquent Takeru Narihira has been having a recurring dream where he is chased by monsters, only for a mysterious girl to always rescue him. Having fallen in love with her, he promises her on their 1,999th meeting that he will be the one to save her the next time. But a motorcycle accident sends Takeru to Denji Heian-kyo—an alternate version of Japan's ancient capital with futuristic technology and the home of the girl from his dreams, Tsukiyima, who does not recognize him.

However, a black mist soon descends upon the city, petrifying citizens and unleashing monsters called oni. Only the so-called onmyouji—sorcerers who wield mystical powers and pilot magical "shikigami" suits—can fight them. When the mist returns, Takeru discovers that he has strange transformation powers and can resist the oni. But he and Tsukimiya are ultimately killed, and Takeru awakens in Denji Heian-kyo once again, this time two weeks before the appearance of the mist. Swearing to protect Tsukimiya at all costs, Takeru vows to become an onmyouji and change the future.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Binan Koukou Chikyuu Bouei-bu Haikara!

synonyms: Cute High Earth Defense Club Haikara!
alternative_titles.en: Cute High Earth Defense Club Love!
alternative_titles.ja: 美男高校地球防衛部ハイカラ！

items.synopsis:
It's the Taisho era—a time filled with the scent of romance, and people's hearts are still filled with compassion.

Unzen, Sukayu, Unohana, Oshamanbe, and Aso are all ordinary (?) male students at Binan High School, who spend their days lazing around in the clubroom of the "do-nothing club" Earth Defense Club, and live together in the Kurotama dormitory.

One day, while the five are taking a morning bath at the Kurotama dormitory, they notice something slimy moving in the bathtub. When they finally manage to catch it, it turns out to be a talking Pallas's cat named Nuru!

Nuru has come from the distant future with a serious mission to inform them that the Earth is facing an impending threat of destruction. While he says he wants to protect the Earth, he says he's only come to warn them of the crisis, and that it's up to the five of them to decide whether or not they want to fight for the Earth...

Isn't this just an attempt to dodge responsibility? The Defense Club members are suspicious. "If either is fine with you, I'll do it! That's more fashionable!" Unzen enthusiastically says. The five decide to fight with free will, and Nuru transforms them into the Haikara Romantic Troupe using feline science.

Meanwhile, a mysterious trio called the Bankara New Elite Squad are scheming in the shadows. They are plotting to take over the Earth.

(Source: Official site, translated and edited)

Arrested for reckless space driving, super human Chiharu and cyborg Makina are sentenced to clean the Milky☆Subway—an old interplanetary train.

Easy enough, right? Wrong. When the train suddenly takes off, they are thrown into a high-speed space-train spectacle packed with chaos, no plans, and zero strategy.

Just pure momentum!

After a strategic maneuver, Senkuu Ishigami's team stalls Dr. Xeno's more scientifically advanced forces. A ceasefire between the two factions allows for the establishment of Corn City in North America, a hope for a future thriving population. Meanwhile, Senkuu and some of his teammates rush toward the Amazon in South America—the epicenter of the petrification beam's impact—to create Superalloy City and progress their spaceship project.

With dangerous enemies still pursuing Senkuu and his companions, it is a race against time to reach the heart of the dense Amazon. As unexpected allies and scientific creations further fuel this leg of their journey, Senkuu is closer than ever to finally uncovering the mystery behind the petrification phenomenon.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.title: Jibaku Shounen Hanako-kun 2 Part 2

alternative_titles.ja: 地縛少年花子くん2 後編

items.synopsis:
Due to frequent misadventures with the supernatural and her hectic school life, Nene Yashiro can barely catch a break until Kamome Academy's annual sleepover event comes around. Nene is excited to blow off some steam with her best friend Aoi Akane and the rest of her class at the get-together. Unbeknownst to her, the sleepover falls on the same date as Urabon, when the line between the dead and the living gets distorted, allowing wicked spirits to come out to the surface.

When an evil ghost is about to attack her, Nene is rescued by a mysterious figure: Shinigami, the Sixth Wonder that can trap souls using his flute. In that moment, Shinigami takes notice of Aoi and abducts her to use her as a sacrifice that will close the barrier for good. Joined by Hanako-kun and Akane Aoi, Nene must embark on a journey into the deepest confines of the world of the dead to save her best friend before it is too late.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Tooi, an ordinary high school girl, was expecting a normal school life—until everything changed on her very first day.

After catching the attention of the unpredictable and overly energetic classmate Jel, she's suddenly roped into the mysterious "Youth Romance Club," a bizarre school group dedicated to chasing down anything that feels "youthful" or "romantic."

What should've been a carefree club quickly spirals into chaotic antics, with Tooi constantly playing the straight man to everyone's nonsense. To make things even wilder, the club's antics start getting streamed online!

Between laughter, unexpected twists, and even a mysterious incident, this unpredictable school life is just getting started.

(Source: MAL News)

Can one embark on a journey to the West without extraordinary abilities? A little pig demon decides to leave Langlang Mountain and team up with a toad demon, a weasel demon, and a gorilla monster to complete their pilgrimage. What trials will the little demons encounter on their westward journey? Will they ultimately be able to achieve their wishes and live the lives they desire?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

items.title: Wo Wei Dao Zong
items.synopsis:
In a conspiracy, the supreme leader of the martial arts world, Dao Zong, was killed, and the leaders of various gangs were either killed or imprisoned, leaving the martial arts world in chaos. In order to rebuild the order of the martial arts world, Yan Jiyu, the leader of Changfeng Pavilion, sent messengers to various sects, intending to establish a new "righteous" martial arts world headed by him. However, at this time, the fledgling Yang Ren was entrusted to deliver a letter left by Dao Zong. Along the way, he was surrounded by powerful enemies and was extremely dangerous, but he relied on his passion and chivalry to constantly break through himself and defeat his opponents. While his martial arts skills improved rapidly, he also met a group of chivalrous and righteous people. What should the martial arts world look like? Yang Ren couldn't answer, but he knew it was definitely not what Yan Jiyu said. Yang Ren put up a big banner: "Chengfeng Gang", and quickly gathered together.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

items.title: Yun Shen Buzhi Meng
items.synopsis:
Yun Wangshu's wedding was meant to be the happiest day of her life, but a brutal conspiracy turned it into a nightmare, slaughtering her entire clan. After a narrow escape, she made a desperate deal with the Silent Court. Now, sixty years later, reborn as the merciless Xihe, she's ready to make her enemies bleed for everything they took from her.

(Source: Youku)

items.title: Da Tang Chengfeng Lu
items.synopsis:
The notorious divinely-skilled Mu Tianhou was suddenly ambushed, causing a stir in the martial arts world. Two upright disciples, Zheng Dongting and Zu Beiqiu (the useless brothers), met each other because of this. In order to help their younger brother Zu Beiqiu find his wife whom he had not seen for ten years, and also to find the real murderer who killed their master, a famous constable and a rich second-generation accidentally teamed up to venture into the world and embarked on an adventurous journey of delivering a divorce letter for thousands of miles. 

The two came to the Luo family in Yangzhou, but encountered the Luo family's massacre and were mistaken for the murderer. They were called "the two evildoers of Central Plains." Between the two of them, Zheng Dongting has martial arts that he cannot use, while Zu Beiqiu has martial arts that he doesn't know how to use. Although the brothers intend to clear their names, the misunderstandings of the various factions in the martial arts world continue to deepen, and the righteous martial arts people rise up to attack them. After experiencing manny dangerous situations, the two discovered that this was a big conspiracy against them...

(Source: iQIYI, Google translated)

items.title: Shuangsheng Wu Hun

When a mysterious demon parasitized Lin Fan and reactivated his abandoned martial soul, making him a rare dual martial soul physique, Lin Fan officially embarked on the road to rise, from a small county town to the heavens and the worlds.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

items.title: Tamala 2030: A Punk Cat in Dark

alternative_titles.ja: Tamala 2030: A Punk Cat in Dark

items.synopsis:
Carefree, coquettish, and capricious, Tamala is the cutest girl-cat in dystopian Cat Tokyo, year 2030—or at any other point in the time/space continuum. She has randomly invited herself along on her detective friend Michelangelo's missing-person investigation. It seems the case is one of seven sudden vanishings in an astronomical pattern across Cat Japan that occurred at the exact same moment one night. Their search leads ever deeper into a mystery with ancient, occult roots and apocalyptic implications—and threads leading to Tamala herself. Shadowed by a covert agent of the Catty & Co. consortium, she may in fact be the greatest enigma. Indolent ingénue? Megacorporate mascot? Mythic messiah, or manifestation of cosmic malevolence? Anyhow, wow—she sure is a great dancer!

(Source: Fantasia International Film Festival)

items.title: Wan Jian Wangzuo
items.synopsis:
In the vast Jiang Dynasty, the culture of swordsmanship has been passed down for millennia, and the people take pride in practicing it. However, reaching its pinnacle, the "Sword God Realm," is a rare feat. Over a decade ago, the once-powerful Wuji Sword God was severely injured by the schemes of the Changsheng Sword God, forcing him to retreat into seclusion in the mountains, detached from worldly affairs. 

Now, Zhan Yibai, Wuji Sword God's only disciple, has finally come of age, and the time has arrived for him to embark on a journey of training as agreed upon by master and disciple. Before departing, to enhance Zhan Yibai's self-defense abilities, Wuji Sword God gifted him his personal sword and instructed him to rapidly achieve the realm of Sword God. New to the secular world, Zhan Yibai befriends Jiang Mingyue, Princess of the dynasty, and Li Kuang, the second son of the Prince of Zhennan. Hoping to rapidly grow, he and his companions participate in the "Ancient Dynasty Ruins" trial, embarking on a remarkable journey.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

items.title: Xiangzhe Xingchen de Changzheng

He was fortunate to be a member of the development team for the Long March 5 (CZ-5), my country's most powerful launch vehicle. Working alongside his predecessors and colleagues, he overcame numerous difficulties, overcame obstacles, and defied external ridicule and skepticism. He rose from the ashes of a failed launch to ultimately achieve success, marking a crucial step in my country's transition from a major space power to a leading space power.

(Source: Bangumi, Google translated)

items.title: Piaomiao Jian Xian Zhuan

synonyms: Legend of the Misty Sword Immortal

items.synopsis:
Dongfang Shaohong, possessing two Dao bodies, but lacking the spiritual roots to awaken his spirit body, is ridiculed by his own clan and even betrayed by his fiancée. Troubles pile up one after another. Dongfang Shaohong's father, imprisoned for possessing the secret to entering the Cangyu Immortal Palace, is trapped by the Immortal Alliance. In the midst of his clan's crisis, Dongfang Shaohong inadvertently uses his own blood to activate the Dao Stone of Immortal Source within him, repelling the Immortal Alliance and saving the clan from the brink. In these dire straits, Dongfang Shaohong is fortunately rescued by his father's friend, Master Ji Yin, and is offered refuge within the Piaomiao Sect. Within the Taiyin Mountain ravine of the Piaomiao Sect, Dongfang Shaohong diligently cultivates, but possessing the Dark Night Dao Body of the Nether Clan is viewed as an anomaly among the human race and constantly harassed by his fellow disciples. Dongfang Shaohong realizes that only by becoming powerful enough can he rescue his father, clear his name, and expose the Immortal Alliance's conspiracy.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

One month into living on his own, Yi-hyuk was hoping for an exciting, dramatic start to his independent life—but not this kind of drama. What he doesn’t expect is to be tormented by the thunderous noise coming from the apartment next door.

Determined to put an end to it, he confronts his neighbor—only to make things infinitely worse when he accidentally punches him in the face.

Yi-hyuk tries everything—from childish pranks to petty power plays—but his neighbor just won’t budge. He even pleads on his knees to make the noise stop. Just when it seems the feud will never end, they finally manage to call an uneasy truce.

And somewhere along the way, Yi-hyuk realizes he might be falling for the very person who once drove him up the wall.

(Source: Laftel)

items.synopsis:
After bidding farewell to the retired Marquis of Dingwu, He Fangzhi, together with the reclusive Zhou Luobin, continues their journey through the martial world to investigate the truth behind his father's corruption case. 

The two travel from the capital to Jiyang City, a key town on the Liaodong border. "The north wind sweeps across the land, breaking the white grass; in the eighth month of the lunar calendar, snow flies in the northern sky," and with the machinations of those behind the scenes, He Fangzhi is besieged by numerous martial arts figures. He Fangzhi and Zhou Luobin overcome numerous obstacles, and the truth behind He Fangzhi's old case and the martial world grudges with He Fangzhi's master in Sichuan, the "Knife Demon," are gradually revealed. 

In each bloody battle, the martial world and the imperial court, choices and perseverance, ideals and conspiracies—the martial world map of Zhen Dao Ge will slowly unfold.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

items.title: Tianming Dashen Huang
items.synopsis:
Xuan Qi, with mediocre talent, was originally just an unranked supernatural being on the list of powerful beings, whose life's ambition was simply to survive to the end in this world, prioritizing safety above all else. However, during an outing, he happened to witness the fierce battle between the Alluring Empress and an ancient demon, becoming an innocent bystander caught in the crossfire. In this critical moment, Xuan Qi unexpectedly activated the "Heavenly Show" system, gaining the ability to continuously gain "Admiration Points" by displaying the demeanor of a peerless master. Subsequently, Xuan Qi, by sheer chance, was forced to appear as the "reincarnation of the God Emperor," seemingly effortlessly slaying the ancient demon and defeating a series of masters from the Otherworldly Demonic Path. 

From that moment on, he became famous throughout the land, revered by the entire Great Victory Divine Continent. Even more miraculously, his every word and action was always misunderstood as having profound meaning. Countless supernatural beings regarded him as a god, while the Otherworldly Demonic Path considered him a major threat.  

(Source: Tencent, translated)

items.title: Jueshi Shen Huang
items.synopsis:
Jing Yunxiao was once the supreme Emperor of Samsara on the Dragon Territory Continent. When faced with a conspiracy, he used the Five-Turn Samsara Technique to be reborn as a young man from the Jing family of Hongye Town. Drawing on his past life memories, Jing Yunxiao helped the Jing family overcome the threat of Black Dragon Village, but his grandfather, Jing Yufeng, was also seriously injured. 

Desperate, Jing Yunxiao shouldered the responsibility of saving his family and journeyed alone to Huangshi City in search of medicine. Misfortunes never come singly. The Jing family, originally an aristocratic family in the capital of Baizhan Kingdom, retreated to Hongye Town to escape the pursuit of the God of War Palace. Jing Yunxiao's reappearance caught the attention of the God of War Palace. To eliminate the root of the problem, the God of War Palace dispatched the assassin organization, the Dark Feather Palace, to Huangshi City to assassinate Jing Yunxiao. 

Meanwhile, Jing Yunxiao, in pursuit of medicine, defeated geniuses from all sides at the Hidden Dragon Competition and bravely entered the Thousand Machines Treasure to win the heart of the icy beauty Mu Shishi. While astonishing everyone with his skills, he also made enemies with many sects. With the sects seeking revenge in front and the Dark Feather Palace hunting behind, how Jing Yunxiao can protect his family and defeat this powerful enemy has become a mystery...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Aria's world is thrown into chaos when Crown Prince Julius, the brilliant but insufferable royal she's sworn to protect as Captain of his Guard, announces her as his future bride. Stunned, Aria confronts him, and Julius offers a way out: if she can defeat him in any competition before the wedding in six months, he'll cancel the engagement. But with Julius' unmatched skills, winning won't be easy. Can Aria outsmart the talented prince and reclaim her life?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

items.title: Huanggu En Chou Lu: Po Feng Pian

synonyms: Chronicles of Grace and Grudges in the Primordial Age

items.synopsis:
Qin Feng, a young man hailed as a once-in-a-millennium genius of the Wuji Kingdom, suffered the humiliation of his entire family being framed and wiped out, leaving him the sole survivor. After his martial meridians were destroyed, he was abandoned in a small, marginalized sect to fend for himself. Driven by a desire for power and revenge, he endured much hardship and bullying, with only his kind-hearted second senior sister, sharing his fate, offering him protection. Unbeknownst to everyone, Qin Feng had already secretly embarked on a difficult path of physical cultivation. 

Upon learning that three members of his sect could study at the Heavenly Dao Academy, and with the spots already secured, he no longer tolerated his fate. When humiliated again by the sect's genius, Yun Tianyu, he unleashed his physical cultivation identity, brutally beating Yun Tianyu and shocking everyone. He then took the initiative, repeatedly teaching Yun Tianyu a lesson and openly challenging the protective First Elder, vowing to secure a spot at the Heavenly Dao Academy, for only through this could he become stronger. To prevent his disciple from being further humiliated, they agreed to a contest in seven days, the winner of which would receive the spot to study at the Heavenly Dao Academy. During this process, Yun Tianyu broke through his cultivation level and unexpectedly became a Holy Son, becoming the object of everyone's admiration. Everyone thought he would win easily. Even his second senior sister advised him to give up and offered to give him her own spot, but Qin Feng refused. In just a few days, Qin Feng also received the Holy Man's inheritance. While shouldering the responsibility of saving humanity, he began to secretly undergo hellish cultivation.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The divine master had intended to emulate other cultivators and plunge into arduous cultivation, but who could have imagined that a chef, appearing out of nowhere, would unexpectedly unlock a new path for him to "level up through food." items.synopsis:
Scientist Chu Feng accidentally obtains the "Golden Crow Token," which fell as a meteorite. To investigate its origin, Chu Feng creates the supercomputer "Origin." With Origin's help, Chu Feng learns that the Golden Crow Token comes from a mysterious world called the Martial Soul Continent. Chu Feng also inadvertently activates the token's power and is transported to the Martial Soul Continent. There, Chu Feng rescues Su Manqing, the third young lady of the Su family, but in doing so, he incurs enmity with the Nangong and Lu families. To cope, Chu Feng quickly familiarizes himself with the martial arts of the Martial Soul Continent while constantly guarding against the Nangong family's schemes, overcoming crisis after crisis. However, gradually, the secret of Chu Feng possessing the Golden Crow Token is discovered by Su Yuwei, the patriarch of the Su family, and others, attracting the covetous eyes of various forces. After escaping a near-death experience, Chu Feng learns of the mysterious prophecy of the "Nine Golden Crow Tokens" from the token on Su Manqing's body. As Chu Feng delves deeper into the Golden Crow Token, the mastermind behind it all gradually emerges, and a secret concerning the survival of the Martial Soul Continent is being revealed…

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
